en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside scene with several steam-powered riverboats moored along a quay. Smoke rises from the funnels, and people are visible on deck. Industrial buildings, a small riverside settlement, and a rail line or loading equipment stand at the base of a steep rocky hillside. On the hilltop, there is a small chapel or church with a steeple and cross, surrounded by fields and trees. The water in the foreground reflects the boats and smoke.
